name: iSAID: A Large-scale Dataset for Instance Segmentation in Aerial Images
description: iSAID is an aerial instance segmentation benchmark dataset developed collaboratively by the CAPTAIN Lab at Wuhan University and the Inception Institute of Artificial Intelligence (IIAI). Built upon the source imagery of the DOTA-v1.0 dataset, iSAID provides high-quality pixel-level polygonal masks for 655,451 object instances across 15 categories (including plane, ship, storage tank, baseball diamond, tennis court, swimming pool, ground track field, harbor, bridge, large vehicle, small vehicle, helicopter, roundabout, soccer ball field, and basketball court). The dataset contains 2,806 high-resolution aerial images ranging from 800x800 to 4000x13000 pixels with a standard split of 1,411 training, 458 validation, and 937 test images. Crucially, iSAID shares identical source aerial imagery with DOTA-v1.0 but establishes an independent, fine-grained instance segmentation benchmark.

provenance.collection_method: Directly reuses the 2,806 source aerial image files originally collected for DOTA-v1.0 from Google Earth and satellite sensors (JL-1, GF-2).
provenance.curation_notes: Replaces DOTA's oriented bounding boxes with professional polygon segmentations outlining 655,451 object boundaries across 15 categories. Explicitly shared source imagery with DOTA (catalog ID: dota).
data_sources: DOTA-v1.0 source aerial imagery (Google Earth, JL-1, GF-2)
